subject: Re: MCMC runs on first call, freezes on second call?

messages.subject: Re: MCMC runs on first call, freezes on second call?
parts:
In case anyone was curious on the follow-up to this: we worked out that the issue did not have to do with nimble.  On the other hand, we do hope to make nimble more flexible for reusing pieces of built and compiled models.
-Perry


On Tue, Aug 22, 2017 at 10:08 AM, Fritz Obermeyer <fritz.o...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all, I'm trying to run an mcmc (example below) with subsampled data. If I restart R and run the script, everything works. If I then change the subsample size and rebuild a model and recompile everything (rerun the entire script), the mcmc freezes before making any progress.

Any ideas what's wrong? Is there some sort of global state that is not being reset when I rerun the script?

Thanks,
Fritz
